pick.headline: Egypt and Israel sign peace treaty
pick.summary: On 26 March 1979 Anwar Sadat and Menachem Begin signed the Egypt-Israel peace treaty at the White House with President Carter.
pick.significance: The treaty took Egypt out of the Arab-Israeli military conflict; Egypt was expelled from the Arab League.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Eastern Europe, Vol. II No. 059, 26 March 1979
evidence.snippet: …iaments approved the draft of the separate agreement concluded between the two countries, Premier Begin and President as-—Sadat, and probably President Carter, are to sign it on Monday. Who benefits from this sepa- rate treaty? (Rainer Koch) comments: That it is not peace but political, economic and military objectives that are at stake is evident from the treaty. And it is even more evident from comments, like the gloss provided by Mr Begin…
